params.name: base
params.description: Filter by specific entity or address involved in the swap. Required — omitting it returns an empty list.

params.name: chains
params.description: Chains to filter by, as a single comma-separated value (e.g. 'ethereum,solana'). If omitted, returns data across all supported chains.

params.name: flow
params.description: Swap direction relative to the base address. Valid values: 'in' (receiving token1), 'out' (sending token0), or 'all'. Defaults to 'all'.

params.name: tokens
params.description: List of token addresses or token IDs that appear as either token0 or token1.

params.name: from
params.description: Filter to swaps where the base sold one of these tokens (token addresses or token IDs). Combine with 'to' for a specific sold/bought trade. To match a token on either side regardless of direction use 'tokens'; to filter by the transaction parties instead, use senders/receivers.

params.name: to
params.description: Filter to swaps where the base bought one of these tokens (token addresses or token IDs). Combine with 'from' for a specific sold/bought trade.

params.name: timeGte
params.description: Filter swaps at or after this time (unix ms, unix seconds, RFC3339, or YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: timeLte
params.description: Filter swaps at or before this time (unix ms, unix seconds, RFC3339, or YYYY-MM-DD).

params.name: timeLast
params.description: Time range filter using relative durations (e.g. 24h, 7d). Cannot be combined with timeGte/timeLte.

params.name: value0Gte
params.description: Minimum token0 amount (decimal-adjusted; matched on absolute value).

params.name: value0Lte
params.description: Maximum token0 amount (decimal-adjusted; matched on absolute value).

params.name: value1Gte
params.description: Minimum token1 amount (decimal-adjusted; matched on absolute value).

params.name: value1Lte
params.description: Maximum token1 amount (decimal-adjusted; matched on absolute value).

params.name: usdGte
params.description: Minimum historical USD value.

params.name: usdLte
params.description: Maximum historical USD value.

params.name: sortKey
params.description: Field by which to sort the results. One of: time, usd.

params.name: sortDir
params.description: Sort direction: 'asc' (ascending) or 'desc' (descending). Defaults to 'desc'.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return. Default: 20. Max: 1649.

params.name: offset
params.description: Pagination offset. offset + limit must not exceed 10000.

params.name: counterparties
params.description: List of addresses or entities to treat strictly as counterparties.

params.name: senders
params.description: Filter by the transaction parties that initiated the swap (sender addresses or entities). Distinct from 'from', which filters on the sold token.

params.name: receivers
params.description: Filter by the transaction parties that received the swap output (receiver addresses or entities). Distinct from 'to', which filters on the bought token.

params.name: protocols
params.description: Filter by protocol/DEX addresses or entity IDs.

items.docs:
Retrieves a list of swaps (DEX trades) based on various query filters.

**Rate Limit**: This endpoint has a stricter rate limit of 1 request per second.
